bio: Treat yourself to a wonderful Afternoon Tea experience at The Petersham. Indulge in a delicious range of treats while enjoying wonderful views of the River Thames.  Afternoon Tea is served in The Petersham Restaurant, featuring a stylish interior as well as a warm and welcoming atmosphere perfect to while away the afternoon.  Their Afternoon Tea menu is a classic interpretation of the great British tradition featuring a selection of traditional finger sandwiches that can be enjoyed before a range of Petersham pastries such as fruit cake and Lemon meringue tartlet. All this can be washed down with a selection of delicious loose leaf teas or if you are feeling in a decadent mood, you can upgrade to include a glass of luxurious Champagne or alcohol-free 'So Jennie'. A vegetarian/vegan Afternoon Tea menu is also available with 24 hours' notice.  Set in Richmond near the beautiful Petersham Meadows, this sophisticated space is just a short drive from Richmond station which offers easy access to central London.
